sentences.english: The forest is so quiet today.
sentences.chinese: 今天的森林真安静。

sentences.english: Let's go camping in the forest this weekend if the weather stays nice.
sentences.chinese: 如果天气一直不错，这个周末我们去森林里露营吧。

sentences.english: I remember hiking in the forest with my grandpa, and he taught me how to identify different birds just by listening to their calls.
sentences.chinese: 我记得和爷爷在森林里徒步时，他教我仅凭鸟叫声就能分辨出不同种类的鸟。
sentences.scene: 祖孙森林探险的教学时光

sentences.english: The river is very cold.
sentences.chinese: 河水很冷。

sentences.english: We had a picnic by the river and watched the boats go by.
sentences.chinese: 我们在河边野餐，看着船来船往。

sentences.english: As kids, we used to spend the whole summer swimming in the river behind our house, only getting out when Mom called us for dinner.
sentences.chinese: 小时候，我们整个夏天都在屋后的河里游泳，只有妈妈喊吃晚饭时才会上岸。

sentences.english: The lake is calm today.
sentences.chinese: 今天的湖面很平静。

sentences.english: We rented a small cabin by the lake for our summer vacation.
sentences.chinese: 我们暑假在湖边租了一间小木屋。

sentences.english: Every winter, when the lake freezes solid, the whole town comes out to skate and play ice hockey under the clear blue sky.
sentences.chinese: 每年冬天，当湖面结冰，全镇的人都会出来在湛蓝的天空下滑冰、打冰球。

sentences.english: We climbed the mountain last weekend.
sentences.chinese: 上周末我们去爬山了。

sentences.english: The view from the top of the mountain was absolutely breathtaking.
sentences.chinese: 山顶的景色简直令人叹为观止。

sentences.english: It was a tough hike up the mountain, and my legs were burning, but reaching the summit just as the sun rose made it all worth it.
sentences.chinese: 登山的过程很艰难，双腿酸痛，但恰好在日出时登顶，让一切都值了。

sentences.english: Let's roll down the hill!
sentences.chinese: 我们从山坡上滚下去吧！
sentences.scene: 孩子们在草地上的嬉戏

sentences.english: There's a beautiful little house on top of the hill with a red roof.
sentences.chinese: 山顶上有一栋红色屋顶的漂亮小房子。

sentences.english: When it snows, we take our sleds to the steep hill by the park and race each other until it gets too dark to see.
sentences.chinese: 下雪时，我们带着雪橇去公园旁那个陡峭的山坡，互相比赛，直到天黑得看不见了才回家。

sentences.english: Don't climb that tree, it's dangerous.
sentences.chinese: 别爬那棵树，危险。

sentences.english: We sat under the big oak tree and read books all afternoon.
sentences.chinese: 我们坐在那棵大橡树下看了一下午的书。

sentences.english: Our old treehouse is still up in that giant maple tree, and even though it's a bit rickety now, it's full of childhood memories.
sentences.chinese: 我们的旧树屋还架在那棵巨大的枫树上，虽然现在有点摇摇晃晃，但里面装满了童年的回忆。

sentences.english: Cross the bridge and turn left.
sentences.chinese: 过桥然后左转。

sentences.english: The old stone bridge in town is a popular spot for taking photos.
sentences.chinese: 镇上那座古老的石桥是个很受欢迎的拍照地。

sentences.english: The bridge was closed for repairs, so we had to take a twenty-minute detour through the countryside, but the extra drive was actually quite scenic.
sentences.chinese: 那座桥因维修而关闭了，我们只好绕道乡间多开了20分钟，但那段额外的路程风景还挺不错的。
sentences.scene: 因封路而意外收获美景

sentences.english: That building is very tall.
sentences.chinese: 那栋楼非常高。

sentences.english: The library is in the old brick building next to the post office.
sentences.chinese: 图书馆在邮局旁边那栋老旧的砖楼里。

sentences.english: The new office building has a rooftop garden where employees can take their lunch breaks and enjoy the view of the city skyline.
sentences.chinese: 新的办公楼有一个屋顶花园，员工们可以在那儿享用午餐并欣赏城市天际线。

sentences.english: I grew up in a small village.
sentences.chinese: 我在一个小村庄长大。

sentences.english: There's a charming village in the valley where they make delicious cheese.
sentences.chinese: 山谷里有一个迷人的村庄，那里的人做的奶酪非常美味。

sentences.english: My grandparents' village is so tiny that everyone knows each other, and you can buy fresh milk straight from the farm next door.
sentences.chinese: 我祖父母的村子特别小，每个人都互相认识，你还可以从隔壁农场直接买到新鲜的牛奶。

sentences.english: That's my house over there.
sentences.chinese: 那边那栋就是我的房子。

sentences.english: We are looking for a new house with a bigger backyard for the kids.
sentences.chinese: 我们在找一栋后院更大些的新房子，好让孩子们有地方玩。

sentences.english: The house I grew up in had a creaky wooden staircase and a front porch where we'd sit on summer evenings and watch the fireflies.
sentences.chinese: 我长大的那栋房子有一条咯吱作响的木头楼梯和一个前廊，夏夜里我们常坐在那儿看萤火虫。

sentences.english: Boating is so much fun!
sentences.chinese: 划船可真好玩！

sentences.english: We went boating on the lake and even saw a family of ducks.
sentences.chinese: 我们去湖上划船了，还看到了一窝鸭子。

sentences.english: My favorite summer memory is going boating with my dad early in the morning when the lake was still misty and perfectly still.
sentences.chinese: 我最喜欢的夏天回忆，就是和爸爸一大清早去划船，那时的湖面雾气缭绕，水波不兴。

sentences.english: Let's go boating this afternoon.
sentences.chinese: 下午我们去划船吧。

sentences.english: If the weather is sunny, we can go boating and have a picnic.
sentences.chinese: 如果天气晴朗，我们可以去划船并且野餐。

sentences.english: We wanted to go boating on the river, but the rental place was closed, so we just sat on the dock and dipped our feet in the water instead.
sentences.chinese: 我们本想去河上划船，但租船点关门了，于是我们就坐在码头上把脚泡在水里，也玩得很开心。
sentences.scene: 计划泡汤后的随遇而安

sentences.english: You aren't going to the party?
sentences.chinese: 你不去派对吗？

sentences.english: These cookies aren't as good as the ones my mom used to make.
sentences.chinese: 这些饼干不如我妈妈以前做的好吃。

sentences.english: We aren't sure if we can make it to the reunion this year because of work, but we're really trying our best to be there.
sentences.chinese: 我们不确定今年能否参加聚会，因为工作的原因，但我们真的在尽力争取能去。

sentences.english: Look at the cute rabbit!
sentences.chinese: 看那只可爱的兔子！
sentences.scene: 在宠物店或野外看到兔子

sentences.english: My little sister wants a pet rabbit more than anything in the world.
sentences.chinese: 我的小妹妹最想要的就是养一只宠物兔子。

sentences.english: We found a wild rabbit in the garden this morning, and it was so tiny and fast that we could barely get a photo before it hopped away.
sentences.chinese: 今天早上我们在花园里发现了一只野兔，它又小跑得又快，我们还没来得及拍照它就跳走了。

sentences.english: The wall is too high to climb.
sentences.chinese: 那堵墙太高了，爬不上去。

sentences.english: The ball flew so high that it got stuck in the tree.
sentences.chinese: 球飞得太高了，卡在了树上。

sentences.english: I have a fear of heights, so walking across that high bridge was terrifying, but I closed my eyes and just kept moving until I reached the other side.
sentences.chinese: 我恐高，所以走过那座高桥简直吓死我了，但我闭着眼睛一直往前走，直到抵达对面。
